title: Boswellia serrata tincture for medicinal use
intro: Boswellia serrata tincture is a concentrated liquid extract made from the resin of the Boswellia serrata tree, commonly known as Indian frankincense. It is widely used in herbal medicine for its anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties. The tincture is typically prepared by soaking the resin in alcohol to extract its active compounds, such as boswellic acids. In herbalism, it is often used to support joint health, reduce inflammation, and alleviate symptoms of conditions like arthritis. It may also be employed for its potential effects on respiratory and digestive health.
